sourceItems.title: DeepSeek's Low-Cost AI Model to Spur Demand for Optical Communication
normalizedClaims: TrendForce projected worldwide shipments of 400G+ optical transceivers to exceed 31.9m units in 2025, +56.5% YoY, with 800G/1.6T demand supported by AI data centers and inference expansion.

sourceItems.title: NVIDIA Q4 FY2025 results
normalizedClaims: Quarterly data-center revenue reached $35.6bn, +93% YoY and +16% QoQ; management described Blackwell demand as very strong.
observedChanges: AI compute demand remains exceptionally strong

sourceItems.title: Microsoft FY25 Q2 results
normalizedClaims: Azure/cloud growth remained strong; AI services grew rapidly and management said demand continued to exceed available capacity while capex stayed aligned to cloud/AI demand.

sourceItems.title: Meta Q4 2024 results
normalizedClaims: Meta guided 2025 capex to $60-65bn, driven by increased investment supporting generative AI and core infrastructure.

sourceItems.title: GE Vernova Q4/FY2024 results
normalizedClaims: Q4 orders were a record $13.2bn +22% organically; Electrification Q4 orders +122% organically, driven by grid equipment/services; equipment backlog grew at better margins.

sourceItems.title: ABB Q4 2024 results
normalizedClaims: Q4 comparable orders grew 7%, led by very strong Electrification growth and particularly high data-center/utilities demand.

sourceItems.title: Gold hits record high, on track for best quarter since 1986
normalizedClaims: Spot gold hit a record above $3,100/oz and gained more than 18% in Q1, supported by trade-war/geopolitical worries, central-bank purchases and ETF demand.

sourceItems.title: China expands critical mineral export controls
normalizedClaims: China imposed export licensing restrictions on tungsten, tellurium, bismuth, indium and molybdenum products after new US tariffs.

sourceItems.title: A tungsten-tipped answer to the West's critical metals dilemma
normalizedClaims: China accounted for the majority of global tungsten production and new export restrictions increased supply-security concerns, while non-China projects sought to restart/expand.

sourceItems.title: LiB Cell Prices Expected to Stabilize in 1Q25
normalizedClaims: After a long 2024 decline, EV/ESS battery prices showed signs of stabilizing as suppliers sought price increases and 2025 demand was expected to grow.

sourceItems.title: Downstream Inventory Reduction Eases DRAM Price Decline in 2Q25
normalizedClaims: Conventional DRAM remained in decline but inventory correction was easing; HBM3e shipments were expected to lift blended DRAM pricing in Q2.

sourceItems.title: Purchasing Managers' Index for January 2025
normalizedClaims: January manufacturing PMI fell to 49.1 and new orders to 49.2.

sourceItems.title: 2025年2月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: February PMI rose to 50.2; production 52.5 and new orders 51.1 returned to expansion.

sourceItems.title: 2025年3月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: March PMI rose further to 50.5; production 52.6 and new orders 51.8.

sourceItems.title: 2025年2月份工业生产者出厂价格
normalizedClaims: February PPI fell 2.2% YoY; non-ferrous material/wire purchase prices rose 11.1% YoY while broad producer prices remained deflationary.

eventClusters.statement: AI infrastructure demand remained capacity-constrained and high-speed optical demand accelerated: hyperscalers guided heavy AI capex, NVIDIA data-center revenue surged, and specialist research projected 400G+ optical-transceiver shipments +56.5% in 2025.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: DeepSeek initially triggered fears of lower compute demand; company-level evidence must distinguish structural optical demand from theme rerating and verify realized earnings.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share optical supplier already converts high-speed demand into earnings and still has favorable timing/asymmetry?

eventClusters.statement: Global electrification/power-equipment demand accelerated into 2025: GE Vernova posted record Q4 orders and +122% Electrification order growth, while ABB reported very strong Electrification demand from data centers/utilities.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Theme already recognized; A-share selection requires pre-cutoff company conversion evidence and favorable timing.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any A-share supplier have an already-realized earnings bridge before March 31, or should this remain a hypothesis only?

eventClusters.statement: Gold reached successive record highs and finished Q1 up more than 18%, supported by trade/geopolitical risk, central-bank purchases and investment demand.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Gold price signal is direct but late in the quarter; company production growth/costs and price absorption must determine selection.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share gold producer combines direct price/volume conversion with the best frozen valuation/timing?

eventClusters.statement: China broadened export controls to tungsten and four other strategic metals, increasing global supply-security pressure and potential pricing power for upstream producers.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Licensing is not an outright export ban and can hurt downstream/export volumes; company earnings bridge must be explicit.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does an A-share tungsten producer have realized price/mix earnings conversion rather than policy optionality alone?

eventClusters.statement: Battery-cell price declines began stabilizing after a prolonged 2024 downcycle as suppliers sought price increases and 2025 EV/ESS demand was expected to grow.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: This is a forecast/early stabilization signal rather than a strong realized earnings change.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there enough realized company evidence to promote, or should this remain weak context?

eventClusters.statement: Conventional DRAM remained weak while HBM shipments/mix were expected to support blended pricing, creating a technology/product-mix divergence rather than a broad memory upcycle.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Most A-share memory suppliers had limited direct HBM exposure, making theme mapping risky.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a clean A-share earnings beneficiary or mainly a foreign-supplier/HBM story?

eventClusters.statement: China manufacturing PMI recovered from 49.1 in January to 50.2 in February and 50.5 in March, with production and new orders returning to expansion.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Broad macro improvement does not define a narrow stock-level beneficiary.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as timing/context rather than standalone long thesis?

eventClusters.statement: Producer prices remained deflationary in February even as non-ferrous input prices rose sharply.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Broad PPI weakness is a margin/context signal, not a standalone opportunity.
